description: Mark a conversation as opened in the LetsBot inbox, and send a read receipt to the customer on channels that support one. This affects inbox read state ONLY. It does NOT clear the conversation from get_conversations_awaiting_reply — only sending a reply does that — so do not call this expecting the awaiting-reply backlog to go down.

phone.description: Phone number of the contact in international format without +

name: mark_as_read
